title: Bind R437 produced Program handoff to descendant row stock
body:
PR4685 left the arithmetic descendant-stock certificate separate from the caller's actual Program and row handoff. This package joins one source-authenticated R437 D SOURCE87 root to the literal produced STEP and `Machine.prepare_child` capsule: at semantic q=3,w=1, **2048 → 64**, depth **0 → 1**, the rows port carries exactly **R/A**, with no extra division by 9475. The unchanged PR4685 arithmetic checker accepts that observed path.

The replay uses the unchanged semantic `checked_entry` continuation, literal directory production, the four-statement `Machine.node` quotient/guard AST with **real binary Count tapes**, actual residual event production, child Program serialization, and typed Program readers. Nineteen controls distinguish source/root/field/precision/STEP failures and locally divisible but unrelated rows. Direct malformed-event controls are witness-boundary checks, not claimed caller bugs; retained descendant ingress already checks width/depth.

**Scope:** only `research/r437-program-stock-path/` is added. This is a historical R437 semantic fixture, outside numerical admission, using the conservative K^D stock and an empty payload. The frozen loader is authenticated against an isolated exact eleven-file historical-source projection, with no disabled guard or frozen-source edits. The retained geometry power adapter is disclosed. No smaller-stock installation, full recursive payload, supplier admission, selected-frontier change or new kappa is claimed; selected kappa remains 0.00302015.

Validation on macOS/Darwin 27 arm64, Python 3.12.2:

- Registered ordinary and optimized replays pass; metadata/pins and all 19 rejection controls pass.
- Committed-byte and source-history preflight pass for all 409 package/input files, relying only on canonical main `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51` as declared Git ancestry.
- Committed export integrity and Git-free replay pass. A modified retained executable is rejected before import; changed live caller source also rejects. All 410 export files, including its manifest, remain byte-identical after controls.
- Main was refreshed before submission without relevant changes; current PR4685 head remains `ca336bd72aff54e025a8ddbb1f3c8b756d9b9631`. Its small stock checker is retained byte-for-byte with origin/hash, so cold replay needs no cached foreign commit.
- Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r437-program-stock-path`.

[Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4682#discussioncomment-19129413). Open next questions separate admitted q127 correspondence, recursive continuation and the complete predicates needed for sharper-stock admission. No selected cold replay, Lean, Docker or full physical payload run was performed.

Credit Mihir Srivastava/PR4685, Chris R/Clear1nsight/PR4067/PR4176, unpaidmoon/PR4147, and the retained caller, Program, geometry and R437 contributors listed in the README. Prepared for Brian (JoyboyBrian) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate adversarial agent reviews; Apache-2.0. Author-checked finite evidence, not human scientific acceptance or formal-kernel verification.

Replaces #4723 under the intended contributor account, JoyboyBrian. The tested commit and research contents are unchanged.
